During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Empatojayos Brand]], [[Bultar Swan/Legends|Bultar Swan]] and [[Chellemi Chuovvick]] were sent on a '''mission''' to the [[Sepan sector/Legends|Sepan sector]] in order to negotiate a peaceful resolution to the [[Sepan Civil War]].

The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] brought the [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]]-long civil war to a [[Standard month/Legends|month]]-long standstill during negotiations. However, upon their return to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the conflict flared up again, this time over whether [[Sepan system/Legends|Sepan]] should [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|secede]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] or not.
